title: client_node computed before spawn, captured by move — correct lifetime
description: client_node is a String allocated from caller.identity before tokio::spawn. The spawn closure captures it by move. This means the identifier is available throughout the lifetime of the coalescing task without requiring Arc or cloning inside the loop. A contributor might suggest computing the identifier lazily inside the loop on the warn branch, but that would require borrowing caller across the spawn boundary, which is not possible since the caller is !Send. The pre-spawn allocation is not only convenient — it is the only correct approach given the ownership constraints.
